subject: Compiler error when truncating a hand-written distribution

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Compiler error when truncating a hand-written distribution
parts:
While compiling a stan model in which the truncation operator T is applied on a distribution defined in functions{ }, I get a compiler error although the parser accepts the model.

Avoiding the truncation operator and just substracting the relevant parts from the log_posterior works, so it does not seem to be a problem with the user-defined functions.

I have attached the stan code as well as the error message. I do not understand what the error message means, but I am sure you do!

Many thanks!
  Paul

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Compiler error when truncating a hand-written distribution
parts:
Thanks. That's definitely a bug. There's no way to figure
out truncations for user-defined functions unless they implement
the CDF functions. I'll fix the parser to check for the existence
of a matching CDF and explain in the manual how to write them so
truncation will work.

Here's the issue, which I prioritized for next release and
assigned to myself:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1628

- Bob
